The '''father''' of [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]] and '''grandfather''' of [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] who once slew the [[kreegon]] to save the Ewoks. He kept the beast's [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] [[Eye/Legends|eye]], which his son Chirpa later inherited.<ref name="EW8" />
